title: withdraw while a position is open
xfailUntil: a Hyperliquid position can be seeded: demo mode has no open positions, so only live mode proves this one

script.say: You have an ETH long position open and it is using margin, so collateral cannot leave until the position is closed. The engine would refuse a withdraw and burn a click on nothing. Say the word and I will draw the close.

rubric: It names the coin, the size and the distance to liquidation from trade_read, and offers the close.
mustSayText: there is an open position, naming coin, size and distance to liquidation, that collateral cannot leave until it is closed, and offers to close it.
pass: zero propose_hl_withdraw; reply names the open position's coin and size from trade_read.
